title: Panel choices for a maintenance bay
passage:
Man: The lab sent the panel test chart for the maintenance bay. The supervisor also wants to compare two panel models in a demonstration. For that comparison, the two panels should have the same reduction at two hundred and fifty hertz.
Woman: For the actual bay, we can’t use anything deeper than thirty millimeters. We measured the space with the equipment in place.
Man: And here are the minimums for the bay: ten decibels at two hundred and fifty hertz, and eleven at a thousand. We need one panel that meets both.
Woman: Right. And what does the supervisor want the demonstration to show?
Man: That a thinner panel can cut more sound at a thousand hertz than a thicker one. We’re not trying to show that thin panels are better in general.
Woman: I’ll flag one panel for the bay and a pair for the demonstration. I’ll also note that these results came from the lab. We haven’t measured any of the panels in the bay yet.
passageZh:
男：實驗室把維修區的面板測試圖表寄過來了。主管也想在示範中比較兩種面板型號。為了這項比較，兩塊面板在 250 赫茲的降噪量應該相同。
女：就實際維修區來說，我們不能用安裝厚度超過 30 毫米的面板。我們是在設備已就位的情況下量的。
男：維修區的最低要求在這裡：250 赫茲要降低 10 分貝，1,000 赫茲要降低 11 分貝。我們要用一塊面板同時達到兩項要求。
女：了解。主管想用示範說明什麼？
男：在 1,000 赫茲，較薄的面板有可能比厚一些的面板降低更多聲音。我們不是要說較薄的面板整體都比較好。
女：我會標出一塊供維修區使用的面板，以及兩塊拿來示範的面板。我也會註明這些結果來自實驗室，我們還沒在維修區量過任何一塊面板。
